repo_conventions.sqlx_pattern: Runtime sqlx::query() + Row::try_get() — NO compile-time macros, NO FromRow derive
repo_conventions.error_handling: thiserror for domain errors, separate Error enum per module
repo_conventions.clippy_enforcement: cargo clippy --lib -- -D warnings must pass with 0 warnings
repo_conventions.commit_style: feat/fix/docs prefix, Wave/Sprint reference in parentheses
repo_conventions.test_pattern: #[cfg(test)] mod tests in same file, cargo test --lib module::submodule

known_fixes.problem: Aes256Gcm does not implement Debug, so Vault struct cannot derive Debug
known_fixes.solution: Manual impl std::fmt::Debug for Vault with redacted cipher field

known_fixes.problem: null::<Type> syntax causes 'no rules expected ::' error inside serde_json::json! macro
known_fixes.solution: Use serde_json::Value::Null instead of null::<Type> inside json! macro

architecture_rules: rand 0.8 is already a dependency — do not add duplicate
base64 0.22 uses Engine trait: use base64::{Engine as _, engine::general_purpose::STANDARD as B64}
aes-gcm 0.10 uses aes_gcm::{aead::{Aead, KeyInit}, Aes256Gcm, Nonce}
Vault master key comes from BROKER_VAULT_KEY env var (64 hex chars = 32 bytes)
broker_connections table uses ON CONFLICT upsert for store_connection()
environment_quirks: TrueNAS ports remapped: postgres=15432, redis=16379, api=18080, frontend=13000
redis v0.24.0 crate shows future-incompat warning — not our code, ignore
SSH to TrueNAS: ssh root@192.168.1.123, docker exec ios-postgres psql -U investor -d investor_os
important_decisions: Vault uses random 12-byte nonce per encryption (not deterministic) for IND-CPA security
BrokerGateway stores encrypted keys with per-field nonces in broker_connections table
gateway.rs uses ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE to allow key rotation without deleting connections
subscriptions table uses user_id UNIQUE constraint for upsert pattern (ON CONFLICT (user_id))
Tier enum uses serde(rename_all = lowercase) so JSON serialization matches DB tier strings
Stripe API uses form-encoded POST bodies (not JSON) for payment_intents and payouts
StripeConnectClient::from_env() returns Option for graceful degradation when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY unset
fiat_transactions table uses CHECK constraints for tx_type and status enums
ssh stdin pipe to docker exec requires 'docker exec -i' flag (not just 'docker exec')
FireblocksClient uses Bearer token placeholder; RSA JWT signing needed for production Fireblocks API
custody_wallets + custody_transactions tables use RLS with app.current_user_id session variable
Fireblocks sandbox base URL: https://sandbox-api.fireblocks.io, production: https://api.fireblocks.io
compliance module changed: top-level #[cfg(feature = eu_compliance)] removed, EU submodules gated internally, KYC always compiled
Created src/regulatory/ as separate module to avoid compliance feature-gate issues — mifid.rs + mica.rs always compiled
